# Best Pictures

> The best movies of the past year, ranked nightly by our AI editor. Built from TMDB and MDBList data. Poll at most once a day.

Each night AI scores every movie released in the last 365 days (0-100, how strongly it would recommend it). A movie's standing score is a running average of its nightly scores, and the top 25 are the standings.

## Files

- [best-pictures.json](https://movies.mickschroeder.com/best-pictures.json): the current standings, 25 movies best first. A JSON array of objects with exactly these fields (same format as the StevenLu popular-movies lists):
  - `title` (string)
  - `tmdb_id` (integer, The Movie Database id)
  - `imdb_id` (string like `tt1234567`)
  - `poster_url` (string URL to a TMDB poster image)
  - `genres` (array of snake_case strings, e.g. `science_fiction`)
- `https://movies.mickschroeder.com/best-pictures-YYYYMMDD.json`: one night's standings in the same format, like Steven Lu's dated `movies-YYYYMMDD.json`, e.g. `best-pictures-20261123.json` (dates are UTC). Files exist from Dec 2, 2019. Nights before this site ranked its own are [Steven Lu's popular-movies](https://github.com/sjlu/popular-movies) lists (15 recent movies, his order); some nights are missing.

## Optional

- `https://movies.mickschroeder.com/year/{year}/` (e.g. `/year/2025/`): every movie ranked that calendar year, best first, from 2019 on
- `https://movies.mickschroeder.com/title/{tmdb_id}-{title}/` (e.g. `/title/1368337-the-odyssey/`): a page for every movie that has been in the standings, with its nightly ranks and links to TMDB, IMDb, Letterboxd, MDBList and others

- [Source code](https://github.com/mick-schroeder/movies.mickschroeder.com): MIT licensed, started as a fork of [sjlu/popular-movies](https://github.com/sjlu/popular-movies)
